summary.name: Elmedia Player
summary.one_liner: Elmedia Player is a macOS media player that plays many video and audio formats without extra codecs and can stream local files to AirPlay, DLNA, and Chromecast devices.
use_cases: Stream local videos to Apple TV or AirPlay devices
Cast movies to Chromecast, Android TV, or Roku
Play AVI, MKV, WMV, or FLV files on a Mac without codecs
Watch movies with external SRT or SSA subtitles
Play and sync audio files with an equalizer
Loop a section of a video with A-B loop
summary.what_it_does: Elmedia is a full-featured macOS player that plays formats such as AVI, MP4, MKV, FLV, WMV, MP3, and OGG without separate codecs. It streams local media over AirPlay 2, DLNA, and Google Cast to devices like Apple TV, Smart TVs, Roku, and Chromecast, with 4K casting mentioned. Subtitles can be loaded from external SRT, SSA, and SMIL files, restyled, synced by delay, and searched through OpenSubtitles.com. The player also offers playback controls such as speed, a video tuner, a 10-band equalizer, screenshots at intervals, A-B loop, deinterlacing, and Picture-in-Picture.
notable: Streams to AirPlay 2, DLNA, and Chromecast/Google Cast devices
Plays many formats without needing codecs installed
Subtitle search via OpenSubtitles.com and external SRT/SSA/SMIL support
Free version plus PRO version starting at $19.95
